title: OEM and machine-platform index
purpose: Discovery index only; official portals help locate manuals but do not prove fault claims. All manufacturer profiles remain portal-only with zero verified alarm-code records. Source-reviewed records are stored separately in knowledge/oem-verified-faults.json.
rules: Do not infer alarm meanings from a portal title, family name, or another model's manual.
Machine builder and component OEM may differ; record both.
Region labels describe company origin or support context, not the actual origin of every machine.
Use official portals as links only. Do not scrape or republish manuals unless rights permit.
If exact model evidence is unavailable, retain general-guidance-not-model-specific status.
